# SmartSave stub conformance transcript v1
# '>' app->bank   '<' bank->app   '@usb CMD [xN]' USB-only command   '@wait N' advance N seconds   '@drain' discard pending output   '#' comment
# Preconditions: SIMULATE_COINS 0 and fresh state (the first step sends FACTORY over USB).
# Rule: before every '>' or '@' step, all previous output must have been consumed by '<' lines.

# S1 fresh bank and PIN setup
@usb FACTORY
> HELLO
< PROTO:1
< AUTH:NEW
> AUTH:1234
< AUTH:NEW
> UNLOCK:1234,5
< AUTH:NEW
> SETPIN:12
< ERR:FMT
> SETPIN:1234,5678
< ERR:FMT
> SETPIN:1234
< AUTH:OK
> HELLO
< PROTO:1
< AUTH:REQ

# S2 login
> AUTH:0000
< AUTH:FAIL
> AUTH:1234
< AUTH:OK
> AUTH:12
< ERR:FMT

# S3 coins, sync, cumulative ack
@usb SIM:5
< COIN:5,1
< TOTAL:5
@usb SIM:20
< COIN:20,2
< TOTAL:25
@usb SIM:10
< COIN:10,3
< TOTAL:35
> SYNC
< TOTAL:35
< LOCK:1
< SEQ:3
< COIN:5,1
< COIN:20,2
< COIN:10,3
< SYNC:END
> ACK:2
> SYNC
< TOTAL:35
< LOCK:1
< SEQ:3
< COIN:10,3
< SYNC:END
> ACK:3
> ACK:9
> SYNC
< TOTAL:35
< LOCK:1
< SEQ:3
< SYNC:END

# S4 unlock and lock
> UNLOCK:0000,10
< AUTH:FAIL
> UNLOCK:1234,0
< ERR:AMT
> UNLOCK:1234,36
< ERR:AMT
> UNLOCK:1234,abc
< ERR:AMT
> UNLOCK:1234
< ERR:AMT
> UNLOCK:1234,30
< TOTAL:5
< LOCK:0
> SYNC
< TOTAL:5
< LOCK:0
< SEQ:3
< SYNC:END
@wait 30
< LOCK:1
> LOCK
< LOCK:1

# S5 lockout after three wrong PINs
> AUTH:0000
< AUTH:FAIL
> AUTH:0000
< AUTH:FAIL
> AUTH:0000
< AUTH:FAIL
> AUTH:1234
< AUTH:WAIT
> UNLOCK:1234,1
< AUTH:WAIT
@wait 31
> AUTH:1234
< AUTH:OK

# S6 adjust
> ADJ:1234,100
< TOTAL:100
> ADJ:1234,100000
< ERR:AMT
> ADJ:1234,abc
< ERR:AMT
> ADJ:1234
< ERR:AMT

# S7 change PIN
> SETPIN:1234,5678
< AUTH:OK
> AUTH:1234
< AUTH:FAIL
> SETPIN:5678
< ERR:FMT
> SETPIN:5678,1234
< AUTH:OK

# S8 misc
> PING
< PONG
> FOO
< ERR:CMD
> SIM:5
< ERR:CMD
> ACK:abc
> THISLINEISWAYTOOLONGTOBEACCEPTED
> PING
< PONG

# S9 replay buffer holds only the last 32 coins
@usb FACTORY
@usb SIM:1 x40
@drain
> SYNC
< TOTAL:40
< LOCK:1
< SEQ:40
< COIN:1,{9..40}
< SYNC:END
> ACK:40
> SYNC
< TOTAL:40
< LOCK:1
< SEQ:40
< SYNC:END
